title: Unhealthy Relationship (Red Flags)
summary: Red flags are warning signs of an unhealthy or abusive relationship: extreme jealousy, checking your phone, isolating you, constant put-downs, explosive anger, threats or pressure for sex.
key_points: Abuse is about power and control and can be emotional, financial, digital, sexual or physical.
answer_guidance: Be supportive, not alarmist. If the user describes danger, gently point to trusted people or helplines (in India: 112 emergency, 181 women's helpline).
